description:
Capability for the main window of the EXPERIMENTAL Tauri build (spec 016,
issue #780). The single custom `refract_request` command needs no explicit permission here --
app-defined commands are callable from every window by default (security/capabilities.mdx).
Capabilities gate webview-to-plugin calls only: Rust-side plugin calls (`repositories.
pickFolder`'s `app.dialog()`, `clipboard.writeText`'s `app.clipboard()`) need no permission here
regardless of what this file grants, so this only covers what the renderer itself may invoke
directly -- the two `opener` scopes the injected `_blank`-link handler needs (`allow-open-url`,
`allow-default-urls`), never the broader `opener:default` (which also grants the unscoped
`reveal_item_in_dir`). `core:default` is the baseline window/app/event permission set every
Tauri window needs.
